answer: Capacity-bounded trust flow resists sybils: honest seeds emit a fixed quantity of vote-capacity that flows along vouch edges under max-flow rules, and the total trust reaching any region is capped by the min-cut of edges crossing into it. A wharf of fakes behind a thin set of attack edges can forge unlimited internal edges, but no extra flow crosses the narrow cut — a lantern on the min-cut shows aggregate sybil trust bounded by attack-edge capacity, not headcount. Honest regions sit behind a wide cedar-dense cut and receive near-full capacity; adding fakes never widens the bottleneck.
